description: This header file declares utility functions related to time measurement used in testing the cURL project. It provides functions to get the current time, calculate time differences, and a platform-specific function for Windows systems for loading system libraries.

methods.name: tutil_tvnow
methods.description: Returns the current time as a struct timeval.

methods.name: tutil_tvdiff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in milliseconds between two timevals, with the first being the more recent.

methods.name: tutil_tvdiff_secs
methods.description: Calculates the difference in seconds with subsecond resolution between two timevals.

methods.name: win32_load_system_library
methods.description: Platform-specific function for Windows to load a system library given its filename.
